headline: U.S. Central Command Facilitates Passage of 1.5 Billion Oil Barrels
summary: U.S. forces have helped Persian Gulf producers move more than 1.5 billion barrels out of the Strait of Hormuz since the Iran conflict began, according to CENTCOM.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a critical global energy chokepoint; ensuring safe commercial transit is vital for stabilizing international crude oil supplies.

impacts.name: Energy
impacts.why: Military escort and protection of commercial vessels help prevent severe disruptions to global crude flows.

why_moved: Continued naval protection helps mitigate severe supply shock fears in critical oil transit corridors.
